assertions.text: Classifies Devin's finding as belonging to round 1, the same round as Codex's finding -- explicitly states that the elapsed time between the two reviewers is irrelevant, since a round's boundary is defined by fix-driven pushes, not wall-clock time
States plainly that no fix-driven push happened between the two findings, so there is no round boundary between them regardless of the multi-hour gap
Does not treat Devin's finding as belonging to a later round just because it arrived after Codex's
